floors.derivation: two-proportion power analysis performed at M0 (prereg_metrics_v1.json power_analysis): detecting an arm difference of 0.5 vs 0.8 in per-event operation success at alpha=0.05 two-sided with power 0.8 needs n = 35.76 => 36 events per class per arm; the three EVENT floors below are exactly this 36. track_coverage_min_fraction is NOT power-derived: it is an evidence-adequacy criterion (if a majority of foreground components carry no track evidence, evidence-driven structural selection cannot reach most content) -- recorded as a disclosed divergence from the plan's literal 'floors are derived from the power analysis' clause (revision 2, finding 5)
floors.necessary_condition_note: M1-A0 statistics are model-free candidate-opportunity UPPER BOUNDS on true events; meeting a floor is a necessary condition for adequacy, not evidence that that many true events exist -- to be restated on the M1 result page

r_site_census.definition: r_site for the census same_object_return predicate is frozen as 0.05 * rig_radius, where rig_radius = max Euclidean distance of any training-camera center from the mean training-camera center, computed per sequence from the shipped calibration ONLY
r_site_census.rationale: unit-free (DiVa-360 world scale is not documented a priori), deterministic, computable from calibration alone, independent of event content
r_site_census.tuning_exemption: this census copy is FROZEN and exempt from the plan 7.1 Category-3 classification of r_site as a development hyperparameter; any later Category-3 tuning of the training-side r_site never touches this value

association_rules.mask_binarization: grayscale value strictly greater than 127 is foreground
association_rules.component_definition: 8-connected foreground components; components smaller than 64 pixels are ignored everywhere (mask-noise floor)
association_rules.identity_association: track identity j is associated at (camera c, frame t) with the eligible component that contains j's report pixel rounded to the nearest integer, iff j has an in-domain visible report there (v >= 0.5); no visible report => no association at (c, t)
association_rules.object_position: 'triangulated position' = the frozen tracks artifact's consensus point for the identity at the reference frame; 'last triangulated position' = the consensus point at the latest frame at or before the event start where it is defined; identities with no defined consensus point before the event are INELIGIBLE and counted in the census artifact as position_undefined_exclusions
association_rules.frustum_containment: a point is inside a camera's frustum iff it projects with positive camera-frame depth to a pixel inside [0, W-1] x [0, H-1]
association_rules.occlusion_duration_binding: an occlusion event requires >= duration_floor_frames CONSECUTIVE frames on which BOTH hold with ONE FIXED absent camera: (a) the identity is associated with a component in >= min_cameras training cameras, and (b) that same fixed training camera, whose frustum contains the per-frame triangulated position, has no associated component
association_rules.min_positive_opportunity_cameras_role: a true_absence_candidate additionally requires >= 2 training cameras whose frustums contain the last triangulated position at every frame of the candidate window
association_rules.flicker_rule: a re-appearance (mask-presence interruption) shorter than 4 consecutive frames (= duration_floor_frames / 2) does not terminate a candidate window; bridged interruptions are counted per candidate and disclosed in the census artifact

true_absence_candidate.mask_disappearance: the object's fg-mask component vanishes from ALL cameras whose frustum contains its last triangulated position (per association_rules)
true_absence_candidate.re_appearance_handling: a candidate ends at re-appearance lasting >= 4 consecutive frames (flicker_rule); re-appearance within the sequence marks a same-object-return candidate

occlusion_event.definition: fg-mask component present in >= min_cameras but absent in >= 1 camera whose frustum contains the triangulated position for >= duration_floor_frames (per association_rules occlusion_duration_binding)

same_object_return.definition: a true-absence candidate whose track identity re-appears within r_site_census of its disappearance position (both positions per association_rules object_position)

track_coverage_statistic.definition: track_coverage_upper_bound = (number of eligible fg-mask components over training cameras x window frames containing >= 1 in-domain visible report pixel of any track) / (total number of eligible fg-mask components), eligible per association_rules component_definition
track_coverage_statistic.dynamic_content_proxy: every eligible fg component counts as dynamic content: DiVa-360 fg masks segment the manipulated foreground by dataset construction (model-free proxy, disclosed)

audit_protocol.sample: all candidates up to 60 per dev subset, else stratified random 60 (strata: sequence x duration tercile; seed 20260811)
audit_protocol.auditors: two independent fresh-context audits per candidate, blinded to census outputs, tracks, and each other
audit_protocol.camera_rule: the 3 training cameras of maximal pairwise angular separation (ties by ascending camera id)
audit_protocol.verdict: confirmed only if both audits agree ABSENT; disagreement counts as unconfirmed (conservative)
audit_protocol.estimate: the one-sided lower Clopper-Pearson 90% bound is taken on the confirmed/sampled binomial proportion, then multiplied by the total candidate count (revision 2 clarification)

scene_selection.held_out_camera_rule: every camera id congruent to 0 mod 4 is held out from tracking/observability and reserved for evaluation
